headline: Solana Implements Major Network Upgrade to Accelerate Settlement
summary: Solana has launched its biggest network change since 2020, featuring a new voting system that targets transaction settlement in about 150 milliseconds to improve payment and deposit speeds.
why: Solana is a major high-performance blockchain platform competing for decentralized application traffic and digital asset settlement volume.

impacts.name: Solana
impacts.why: Significant architectural enhancements that improve transaction speed and reliability can drive increased network adoption and user demand.

why_moved: Network performance upgrades reduce latency and enhance utility, attracting heightened speculative and operational interest in the underlying token.
